entry.name: matrix
entry.description: The matrix object controls the connections between inlets and outlets. You can route any inlet to any combination of outlets. Each connection has an associated gain factor and all values travelling through matrix can be scaled. It shares the same control protocol with the signal matrix~ object, but unlike matrix~, the outlets of the matrix object do not add the values of multiple inputs. matrix is best understood as a combination of gate and switch with many more features.

arguments.description: Sets the number of inputs; if not present the default is 2.

arguments.name: number-of-outputs
arguments.description: Sets the number of outputs; if not present the default is 2.

arguments.name: default-connect-gain
arguments.description: If a float value is provided as a third argument, it sets a default gain to be used for themessage when a gain argument tois not supplied.

messages.name: clear
messages.description: In left inlet: Themessage removes all inlet - outlet connections.

messages.name: connect
messages.description: In left inlet: The wordfollowed by an inlet index, outlet index, and optional gain, adds a connection between the inlet and outlet. If the gain value is not present, the default gain (set either via typed-in argument or theattribute) will be used for the connection.

messages.name: dictionary
messages.description: The wordfollowed a symbol naming a Max dictionary object, replaces all connections with the ones in the dictionary. If the dictionary has no connections, the existing connections are cleared. To see the format of the dictionary, send themessage and print or otherwise capture the resulting dictionary that is sent out the object's left outlet.

messages.name: disconnect
messages.description: In left inlet: The wordfollowed by an inlet index and outlet index deletes a connection between the inlet and outlet if it exists.

messages.name: dumpconnections
messages.description: Themessage outputs a Max dictionary message listing all current connections of theobject.

messages.name: list
messages.digest: Connect or disconnect; data to be routed
messages.description: In left inlet: A list either adds or removes a connection between an inlet and outlet. The format of the message is(starting at 0 for the object's secont inlet from left),(starting at 0),. A non-zero gain adds a connection with the designated gain; a gain of 0 deletes the connection if it exists.A list received in any other inlet is routed to any connected outlets.

inlets.description: The leftmost inlet is dedicated to messages to add or delete connections between the other inlets and outlets.
The other inlets receive messages that are relayed to any outlets connected to the inlet.

outlets.description: The leftmost outlet will output a dictionary containing a list of the current connections in response to themessage.
The other outlets output messages that are relayed by any connected inlets.
